answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond and build a verifiable history before it can trade: each identity becomes a vertex in a public reputation graph, linked only by completed, attested work. A newcomer starts in the umber zone of low trust, with strict rate limits, and earns higher limits only as peers attest its deliveries. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real stake and time per identity, while a ferrous audit trail of signed receipts that cannot be quietly rewritten lets the network detect clusters that vouch for each other and slash their bonds.
